Career

At EaseMyTrip, we believe that cheerful work environment and employees make a good team. Healthy teamwork is the prime mantra behind making EaseMyTrip, one of the top five online travel portals in India.
We strongly believe in creating happy environment for employees to make them more committed towards their works and get the best efforts out of them. Thus, we constantly seek for bright and innovative professionals that can be a part of our employee-pool. We provide career opportunities that are second to none.

Call us: 011- 4313-1313, 4303-0303 or Mail us: hr@easemytrip.com

Current Openings:

Flight Support

Job Description:

  • Freshers with good communication skills will work candidates will work.
  • Freshers from travel domain with good communication skills
  • Experienced customer support candidates in travel domain
  • Ready to work in rotational shifts ( No Night Shifts for females )



Skills Required

  • Knowledge -international/domestic travel voice process
  • Knowledge of world map & geography will be required.
  • Be enthusiastic & have zeal to perform.
  • Be flexible to work in 24*7 rotational shifts days working environment.
  • Candidates should be able to join ASAP.
  • Excellent communication skills required.
  • Provide best-in-class customer service and problem resolution to customer queries over the voice based phone service.
  • Support customers across Telecommunication/E- mail/Chat, Meet customer requirements through first contact resolution.
  • Clarify customer requirements; probe for and confirm understanding of requirements or problem.
  • Greet customers in a courteous, friendly, and professional manner using agreed upon procedures.
  • Listen attentively to customer needs and concerns; demonstrate empathy.
  • Confirm customer understanding of the solution and provide additional customer education as needed.
  • Prepare complete and accurate work and update customer file.

International Ticketing

Job Description:

  • Handling Reservations & Ticketing (International)
  • Handling Bookings, Documentation, Complaints handling, etc.
  • Handling Refund and Cancellation of International Air Tickets.
  • Should be well-versed on GDS Galileo


Skills Required
  • IATA qualified/any other relevant Travel and Tourism qualification would also be an advantage
  • Minimum Experience of 0-3 year is required
  • Good Communication written and verbal
  • Should be well-versed on following GDS Galileo

International Holiday Packages Sales

Job Description:

  • Minimum experience of 2-7 year is mandatory.

  • Should have good knowledge of international destinations.
  • Hotel bookings, flight bookings, making land operator arrangements and negotiating deals with hotels.
  • Converting Genuine Leads in to business.
  • Preparing Tour costing
  • Communication to the clients
  • Handing Entire Tour Operations
  • Designing Attractive Package Itineraries
  • Understanding Client's Package Requirements
  • Presenting, Convincing & Selling Tour Package to Clients
  • Follow up from guest

Seo Analyst

Job Description:

  • 3+ years of SEO experience, proven track record of successful SEO strategy and implementation.
  • Collaborate with the product and tech teams to drive initiatives for best user experience, site architecture and content, impacting rankings of category keywords in organic search result
  • Develop link-building strategies, link architecture and ensure spider friendliness of the website
  • Manage tactical execution of organic search strategies that include, performing regular site audits, comprehensive and complex keyword research, analysis and portfolio management to identify and drive growth opportunities; On-site content optimization;
  • Ownership & reporting of key SEO performance metrics.
  • Perform keyword research and analysis from Google adwords tool and other commonly used tools
  • Log file analysis and traffic reporting, and other topical trends in SEO
  • Develop reports on organic metrics, and possess working knowledge of Google Analytics and other commonly used tools
  • Manage and drive SEO reporting build, develop and present weekly updates to demonstrate the impact of company's investment to senior management
  • Develop and maintain social media profiles on platforms like Twitter, Facebook & LinkedIn.
  • Develop pay-per-click advertising campaigns on platforms like Google Adword
